examples.text: Уго́н соверши́л второ́й пило́т самолёта из-за́ того́, что был не удовлетворён свои́м положе́нием на слу́жбе
examples.translation: The hijacking was committed by the co-pilot of the plane because he was not happy with his position in the service.
examples.english: The hijacking was committed by the co-pilot of the plane because he was not happy with his position in the service.
